answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by requiring each identity to prove work before it can influence anything. A newcomer stakes collateral, takes randomized jobs, and gathers signatures from reviewers outside its cluster. A jade ledger stores every verified result, a yarrow tally tracks durable reputation, and a kernel of consensus validates each step before privileges unlock. Audits slash faked histories, so spawning identities multiplies cost and scrutiny rather than voting power.
